business: Native typed carriers and the existing portable request/v3 JSON represent the same candidate data. Encoding does not resolve meanings, assess readiness, select owners or grant authority.
bridge: Native AlchLang Mappings select all field aliases, exact integer/JSON-text codecs and tagged-union representations. The generic schema-directed encoder performs only those explicit data encodings.
system: Walk typed structure in postorder; fields declared opaque are not traversed. Apply bounded, closed-local JSON Schema matches and explicit Rename/Integer/JSON-text/Unwrap/Project/Remove/DefaultNull encoding actions. Construction uses the existing generic encoder; no executable expressions or function callbacks are accepted.
invariants: Embedded and local revision and original-file byte counts preserve exact integer values.
Opaque task values and JSON Schema literals are not reinterpreted by recursive field codecs.
Only the three optional predecessor/language/supplement fields are omitted when absent on portable export.
Field aliases and union tags are supplied by authored AlchLang, never hardcoded in the runtime.
allowed_runtime_basis: strict JSON encoding/decoding and schema validation against explicit source-selected schemas
